title: The idea, its name, and Hypha's roadmap
done: In one long conversation the author's idea was worked into its vocabulary (rhizome, node, shoot, conjure, graft), the manifesto was written, and Hypha's roadmap was drawn and redrawn until graft stood in the first milestone, the store was one per machine, and the graph - not text - was the source of truth.
considered: A store per project; ending the first milestone before graft; text as the content with structure as its index; starting at the kernel.
rejected: All four - each corrected by the author in that conversation.

title: A home for Rhizome
done: The author's manifesto, and the concepts, decisions (with what was rejected), roadmap and path drawn from it and from the conversation, kept the ocoeco way in the author's new organization, with a lens curated in the observatory. On the periphery by the author's choice: recorded whole, not being built yet. Read from the gist in full and from one conversation; later conversations inside a project could not be read from here.
considered: Moving Rhizoid's repositories here at once.
rejected: That, for now: a transfer changes their addresses; the lens gathers Rhizoid where it is.

title: Its idea, told for anyone
done: The idea of Rhizome written as an ordered piece of writing in its own data - what it is, what it is for, a picture, its honest limit, where it stands - for a reader who knows nothing of it; shown by the observatory as an article.
rejected: Those as the idea: they name the parts for an insider.

title: Its workings, told
done: What delivered the one step reached - the idea, whole: the manifesto, the roadmap, the decisions. Every later step is left with nothing under it: nothing is built yet.
rejected: Listing planned tools as if they delivered anything.
